name: Saints
overview: Scripture identifies saints as those called and set apart by God, as seen in Paul's greetings to the believers in Rome, Ephesus, and Philippi (Romans 1:7; Ephesians 1:1; Philippians 1:1). The Psalms encourage the saints to sing and give thanks to the Lord, highlighting their role in worship (Psalms 30:4). The Spirit intercedes for the saints according to God's will, emphasizing direct divine care and advocacy for believers (Romans 8:27). While the Bible acknowledges the identity and calling of saints, it does not teach praying to or venerating saints apart from God.
